Professional Summary
Data engineer with strong track record building scalable data pipelines, transformation frameworks, and analytics-ready data platforms. Experienced in designing and operating streaming and batch ETL, optimizing SQL performance, and enabling self-serve analytics for product and business teams.

Technical Skills
Python 3, SQL, Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, Snowflake, dbt, Apache Kafka, Agile

Work Experience

Senior Data Engineer, Quanta Retail (Aug 2023 - Present)
- Implemented streaming ingestion for clickstream and POS events using Apache Kafka to reduce latency for near-real-time analytics; designed Kafka topics and consumer groups to handle 200k events/min and ensured <2s processing lag using micro-batching.
- Built dbt models and transformation DAGs to standardize product and inventory dimensional tables in Snowflake, improving downstream query performance by 40% while enforcing column-level tests.
- Developed SQL-based data quality checks and automated alerting for pipeline failures; collaborated with Agile squads to deliver fortnightly increments and shorten incident resolution time.

Data Engineer, Finlytics (Nov 2020 - Jul 2023)
- Developed batch ETL pipelines in Snowflake with optimized SQL and materialized views to serve risk scoring and reporting workloads, cutting query costs by 35%.
- Orchestrated end-to-end workflows using Apache Airflow, creating modular DAGs, retries, and SLA monitoring to ensure reliable daily data delivery to analytics consumers.
- Partnered with analytics and ML teams to build feature tables and maintain lineage, applying SQL-based transformations and implementing access-controlled Snowflake schemas.

Big Data Engineer, Swiggy (Aug 2019 - Oct 2020)
- Built and tuned Apache Spark jobs for large-scale order and logistics data processing, reducing job runtime by 50% through partitioning and optimized SQL joins.
- Authored complex SQL to aggregate delivery and rider metrics, enabling near-real-time dashboards for operations and improving metrics freshness.
- Collaborated in Agile sprints to integrate new data sources and maintain robust ETL schedules.

Big Data Engineer, Dream11 (Feb 2018 - Jul 2019)
- Implemented Spark-based pipelines for event processing and feature extraction for recommendation and analytics systems; optimized transformations using data frame APIs and SQL.
- Designed Snowflake data models and ingested cleansed datasets into Snowflake for reporting and BI consumption.
- Wrote Python 3 scripts to automate data validation, ingestion tasks, and pipeline monitoring within CI workflows.
